body:
**Scope:** 121 functions where the Jev security battery judged fail-closed < 0.5
(fail-open-on-error risk). Top 10 by blast_radius:

- `runSizingUncached` (`assets/js/sizing/run.js:417`) fail-closed 0.18, blast_radius 2.97
- `applyI18n` (`assets/js/shared/i18n.js:113`) fail-closed 0.13, blast_radius 2.94
- `handleWorkerRequest` (`scripts/lib/worker-bridge.mjs:91`) fail-closed 0.45, blast_radius 2.92
- `fetchHourlyCached` (`assets/js/sizing/nasa.js:371`) fail-closed 0.13, blast_radius 2.90
- `refreshSelectionOutputs` (`assets/js/sizing/ui.js:7389`) fail-closed 0.11, blast_radius 2.89
- `runSizingCore` (`assets/js/sizing/run.js:375`) fail-closed 0.15, blast_radius 2.88
- `setCoords` (`assets/js/sizing/ui.js:2181`) fail-closed 0.11, blast_radius 2.85
- `mergeReSlice` (`assets/js/sizing/ui.js:3018`) fail-closed 0.15, blast_radius 2.80
- `monthName` (`assets/js/sizing/ui.js:6939`) fail-closed 0.10, blast_radius 2.73
- `reset` (`assets/js/sizing/location-picker.js:104`) fail-closed 0.12, blast_radius 2.67

Full list: `audit.db` table `battery_security` (fail-closed < 0.5), per-function CSV in PR #193.

**Method:** per function, decide: harden to fail-closed with a test, or disposition as
fail-open-by-design with a reason (sizing fallbacks that degrade gracefully are the
expected bulk of dispositions).

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Every function dispositioned: hardened with tests, or fail-open-by-design with reason
- [ ] CI green

Part of the Jev completion program.
**Calibration (applies to every car):** prescription confidence runs 0.39-0.66, nowhere near the 0.95 gate. The granularity pass shows fit-argmax agreeing with the prescription choice only 4% of the time, with `no-change` the top fit in 59% of functions. **Prescriptions are a ranked suspect list, not work orders.** Only items at >=0.95 are execution-ready; everything below needs lane review against the granularity fits in `prescriptions.csv` (https://github.com/Sovereign-Communication/BigEnergyCo/pull/193) before any code changes.

Tracker: #194

---
## Phase A iteration verdicts (2026-10-06)

Disposition battery converted all 121 items to verdicts: **55 acceptable-fail-open** (dispositioned out — failing open is safe there), **51 must-fix**, **15 needs-human-look**.

**Must-fix — production (`assets/`, `worker/`) — 11:**
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:5015` `purchasePaths` (silent-wrong-output, conf 0.85)
- `assets/js/sizing/location-picker.js:25` `el` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.57)
- `worker/index.js:547` `callGroq` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.57)
- `assets/js/sizing/run.js:417` `runSizingUncached` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.45)
- `assets/js/sizing/nasa.js:115` `buildUrl` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.43)
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:2181` `setCoords` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.38)
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:3018` `mergeReSlice` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.38)
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:4361` `renderRelativeOptions` (silent-wrong-output, conf 0.36)
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:6170` `applyGenRate` (lost-user-action, conf 0.35)
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:2152` `markPrecalcDirty` (stale-data-shown, conf 0.22)
- `assets/js/sizing/run.js:305` `fetchWeatherWithFallback` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.04)

**Must-fix — tests/scripts (tooling) — 40**, top by confidence:
- `tests/weather-persistence.test.mjs:110` `put` (security-bypass, conf 0.86)
- `tests/weather-persistence.test.mjs:116` `delete` (silent-wrong-output, conf 0.85)
- `tests/jev-sanitize.test.mjs:360` `fetch` (silent-wrong-output, conf 0.76)
- `scripts/smoke/advisor-fallbacks.mjs:209` `fetch` (security-bypass, conf 0.73)
- `tests/perf-budget.test.mjs:247` `stubPowerFetch` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.73)
- `scripts/smoke/lifecycle.js:7` `runLifecycleFlow` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.66)
- `scripts/serve-static.mjs:91` `applyPolicy` (security-bypass, conf 0.65)
- `scripts/smoke/privacy.mjs:57` `runPrivacyFlow` (security-bypass, conf 0.65)
(40 total in tooling; full list in `audit.db` table `dispositions`.)

**Needs-human-look — 15** (specific question for a human who knows product intent), production items:
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:5059` `band` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.54)
- `assets/js/sizing/ui.js:1319` `applianceState` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.22)
- `assets/js/sizing/run.js:375` `runSizingCore` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.17)
- `assets/js/sizing/run.js:291` `fetchWeatherOnce` (ui-crash-freeze, conf 0.13)

Acceptance update: fix the 51 must-fix (production first), record a decision on the 15 needs-human-look, CI green. The 55 acceptable-fail-open are closed out by this verdict.
Per-function verdict data: PR #193 (`docs/jev-completion/VERDICTS.md`, refreshed). Calibration still applies: these are ranked suspects, not work orders.

---
**Unblocks:** #171 quality ratchet — the 10 must-fix dispositions on #171's files (`ui.js::purchasePaths`, `renderRelativeOptions`, `mergeReSlice`, `markPrecalcDirty`; `run.js::runSizingUncached`; `nasa.js::buildUrl`; `location-picker.js::el`) are the "partial evidence" half of the 85→60 ratchet. See #171 for the full list.
